temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose notices Patricia is more withdrawn than usual and recalls her as normally vibrant. When he asks if she is okay, she says it is just personal stuff, thanks him, and appreciates his offer to listen.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia is usually vibrant and has not previously shown obvious signs of trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. He moves from no specific concern to concern that Patricia may be dealing with personal difficulties, though she has not shared details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia may be troubled by something personal and is not ready to discuss it, but she appreciates his support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Be available to listen and support Patricia without pushing her to share more than she wants.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments. When he offers to discuss financial planning, Patricia confirms she has been overwhelmed by bills and says she will take him up on help soon.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia may be dealing with personal troubles and appreciates his willingness to listen, but he does not yet know the specific source of her distress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. He now understands that financial stress is a concrete source of Patricia's worry and that she is open to discussing it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is stressed and overwhelmed by bills and financial commitments, and she may accept practical help with budgeting or financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, sympathetic, and somewhat motivated to help practically.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer practical financial planning or budgeting support when Patricia is ready.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose worries he may have overstepped by raising financial planning. Patricia reassures him that she did not think he was prying and says she is grateful for his offer. Jose says he respects her privacy and wants to support her as a friend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia is financially stressed and may be open to his help, but he is uncertain whether his offer felt intrusive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. His worry about overstepping is replaced by reassurance because Patricia explicitly says she is grateful and does not see him as prying.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia welcomes his supportive help as a friend and does not view his concern as an invasion of privacy.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Patricia as a friend while being careful to respect her privacy and boundaries.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose checks in casually and asks about Patricia's weekend. She says everything is good and she is planning a quiet weekend at home, then thanks him when he offers to chat if needed. Jose senses she appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia is grateful for his support and does not see his concern as overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. He adjusts his understanding: Patricia appreciates his concern, but she seems to prefer privacy and may not want active involvement right now.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia values his support but wants to handle her personal or financial issues privately; he should remain available without prying.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Respectful, supportive, and slightly cautious about overstepping again.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain a friendly, supportive presence and let Patricia take the lead if she wants to talk or ask for help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose continues checking in supportively at work. Patricia says she is busy but handling it, thanks him for checking in, and says it is great to have his support. Jose replies that he is available anytime and frames it as mutual workplace support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia values support but prefers privacy and may want to handle her issues on her own.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Slightly, but mostly reinforces his prior belief: Patricia is managing, appreciates low-pressure support, and does not seem to need immediate intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is busy but handling things, and she appreciates his supportive check-ins as long as they remain low-pressure and respectful.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Supportive, warm, and reassured that his presence is helpful without being intrusive.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue offering low-pressure support and check-ins, remaining available for help or coffee without pushing for details.
